sentences.text: [slightly surprised] This wedding toast is named after a man drinking a stranger's bathwater.
[pause] And yes, the word really means toast.
You see, people used to drop spiced toast into wine, to make cheap wine taste better.
Now, in the town of Bath, crowds watched people soak in hot public pools.
One day, a famous beauty stood in the water.
[in disbelief] A man scooped a glass of her bathwater, and drank it to her health.
So what did his drunk friend do?
He said forget the drink, he wanted the toast. She was what flavoured it. Then he tried to jump in after her.
At least, that's how a London magazine told it.
After that, whoever everyone drank to was called the toast.
[lowering their voice] So every wedding toast is named after a man drinking a stranger's bathwater.
And no, that was never romantic.
